title: Johannes Radebe Insists He Will Still Dance on Strictly Come Dancing Despite Host Duties
text:
Johannes Radebe has reassured fans that he will still be dancing on Strictly Come Dancing despite taking over host duties. The 39-year-old star has been announced as one of the presenters alongside Emma Willis and Josh Widdicombe, taking over the Latin and Ballroom dance programme in September.
Johannes Radebe has reassured fans that he will still be dancing on Strictly Come Dancing despite taking over host duties . The 39-year-old star has been announced as one of the presenters alongside Emma Willis and Josh Widdicombe , taking over the Latin and Ballroom dance programme in September.
Johannes has confirmed that he will still be hitting the dancefloor as it is a huge part of his life and will be a 'travesty' if not. He has stated that there is a 'plan' in action for him to still dance on the show and has reassured fans that his dancing shoes will not be hung up.
Johannes has also shared behind the scenes clips with his new co-stars Emma and Josh, where they discuss their excitement and nervousness about the upcoming season. In one clip, Josh joked that he feels the same as Johannes about not being part of the dancing team and having to interview them. Emma added that she is feeling the same way, with her 'tummy flipping consistently' with excitement.
Johannes has also stated that he will definitely be throwing some shapes and moving his hips on the dancefloor, and that it would be a 'travesty' if he didn't. The final clip featured Josh speaking about his new colleagues Emma and Johannes, where he described Emma as 'one of the great TV hosts of our generation' and Johannes as 'one of the great dancers of our generation'.
Josh also joked that he looks like a 'disaster' compared to his new colleagues, but is looking forward to the first episode of the show. The new season of Strictly Come Dancing is set to be a exciting and highly anticipated one, with Johannes and his new co-stars Emma and Josh bringing their own unique energy and style to the show.
The show will feature a new line-up of celebrities and professional dancers, and is set to be a must-watch for fans of the show. In a related development, Strictly bosses are said to be 'set to sign stunning new dancer to replace Nadiya Bychkova' after she was axed. The news has left fans of the show eagerly anticipating the new season and wondering who will be the new star of the show.
With Johannes and his new co-stars Emma and Josh at the helm, the new season of Strictly Come Dancing is shaping up to be one of the most exciting and highly anticipated ones yet.
